written_before: any feature is computed on, and any model is fitted to, these data
question: How much of the published independent-test AUROC on the pLMSNOSite S-nitrosylation benchmark can a model reach that sees only 25 in-silico tryptic-digest features of the site's peptide (no residue identity, no evolutionary, structural or language-model information)?

data.source: https://github.com/KCLabMTU/pLMSNOSite, commit e9158af06418f3e50c9bbbbeca77ea692e6507ce, data/train/sequence_train.csv and data/test/sequence_test.csv (Apache-2.0)
data.rows: used as released: training 3,276 positives / 3,276 negatives (1,918 proteins); test 351 / 3,168 (278 proteins); every Position is a cysteine in the released sequence (checked)
data.declared_discrepancy: the paper states 3,383 training SNO sites; the released balanced training file has 3,276. The released files are used and the published test-set numbers are taken as published.

features: DIG25 = run_cross_protease_detectability_probe.FEATURE_NAMES (25 columns), computed by its features() with the Trypsin rule on the released full sequence; Position is 1-based and converted to a 0-based index
model: sklearn HistGradientBoostingClassifier(**run_cross_protease_detectability_probe.HGB_KWARGS), fixed configuration, no tuning, no calibration, one fit on the full released training set; interpreter: project venv (Python 3.9.6)

published_reference_auroc.source: Pratyush et al. BMC Bioinformatics 24, 41 (2023), doi 10.1186/s12859-023-05164-9, Table (independent test set; values for other tools adopted from PreSNO)

primary: test-set AUROC of the DIG25 model, with a 95% protein-clustered bootstrap interval over test proteins (5,000 replicates, seed 20260924)
recovery_ratio: R = (AUROC_DIG25 - 0.5) / (0.754 - 0.5), against pLMSNOSite; the same ratio against PreSNO and DeepNitro is reported as secondary

branches.B1: R >= 0.75 and the AUROC interval's lower bound > 0.5: detectability-only features recover most of the published discrimination on this benchmark
branches.B2: 0.25 <= R < 0.75 and the lower bound > 0.5: detectability-only features recover a substantial minority of it
branches.B3: R < 0.25, or the interval includes 0.5: the published discrimination on this benchmark is largely not reproduced by detectability features

controls.NC: the same model fitted after permuting the training labels (seed 20260924): its test AUROC interval must cover 0.5, else the pipeline is broken and no result is used
controls.PC: 5-fold cross-validated AUROC on the training set, reported as a check that the features carry signal where the published models were trained

secondary_descriptive: the VIS10 subset (10 visibility-only columns) with the same model
declared_caveats: the benchmark split is by site, not by protein; the number of proteins shared by training and test sets is reported
negatives are other cysteines of SNO-bearing proteins, the construction this study questions; the comparison is about what the benchmark rewards, not about S-nitrosylation chemistry
published AUROCs are quoted, not recomputed
commitment: whichever branch results is reported in the manuscript and a Supplementary Note with the same prominence; no feature, model or threshold is changed after the test set is scored
